subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload path, and what exact upload validation, storage path, overwrite behavior, auth scope, and identity-precedence rules should it use?
rationale: The implementation shape crosses a new server-side binary upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or product precedence policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload contract
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that validates image type and size, stores under a fixed workspace-relative avatar path, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-route protections.

options.title: Keep manual and local-only paths
options.body: Continue supporting manual identity edits, `agents.update` avatar strings, and browser-local overrides while avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer broader identity management
options.body: Keep this issue open only as part of a broader Control UI identity-management design rather than landing a one-off upload route.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that validates image type and size, stores under a fixed workspace-relative avatar path, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision needs maintainer-level security/product ownership, and steipete is tied to the original avatar support merge and likely product boundary ownership.
